entities.name: Peter the Athonite
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Peter the Athonite, sometimes called Peter of Mount Athos, is reputed to have been the first hermit to settle upon the Mount Athos. He is venerated as a saint and commemorated by the Eastern Orthodox, Eastern Catholic and Roman Catholic Churches on June 12.
